title: Length of the it_companies set
description:
Given the set `it_companies = {'Facebook', 'Google', 'Microsoft', 'Apple', 'IBM', 'Oracle', 'Amazon'}`: Find the length of the set it_companies.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `it_companies_length(it_companies)`, returning the number of elements in the given set.
hints: A set stores a collection of unique items, and Python has a built-in way to count how many items any collection holds.
The same function you'd use to count the items in a list also works directly on a set.
Use Python's built-in len() function on the set argument and return its result.
expected_behavior: Returns the number of elements contained in the given set.
explanation: len() works on any collection type, including sets, and returns the count of elements it currently holds - since sets store only unique values, this is also the count of distinct items.
